name: fit-ride-studio
title_zh: 把骑行跑步徒步的轨迹变成体检报告和路线大片
tagline_zh: 上传 FIT/KML，自动出数据报告、对比多次训练，还能生成 PNG 或 MP4 路线故事。本地环境支持时。
tagline_en: Drop FIT/KML files, get evidence-based reports, compare rides, and export route stories as PNG or MP4. Opens the.
desc_en: Analyze one or more cycling, running, or hiking FIT/KML activity tracks, generate evidence-based single or aggregate reports, open the bundled local Ride Relief report page when the environment supports it, enrich results with user-confirmed public location context, and create shareable PNG or H.264 MP4 route stories on request. Use whenever a user wants to analyze, compare, visualize, or export .
why_zh: 不只是画轨迹，它把运动数据变成可分享的叙事：聚合多文件、叠加公开地点背景，报告和视频都基于真实数据。
why_en: It turns raw tracks into shareable narratives—aggregating multiple files, enriching with public place context, and generating.
limit_zh: 只认 FIT 和 KML 两种格式；报告是统计汇总，不做逐秒功率分析；PNG/MP4 导出依赖本机 ffmpeg 和字。
limit_en: Only FIT/KML inputs; reports are aggregate stats, not second-by-second power analysis; PNG/MP4 export needs local ffmpeg and fonts; location context.
